# MrPPC.pk

> MrPPC.pk is the PPC management service of Syed Mudassir Shah, a PPC expert with 15 years of experience in paid advertising. He plans and manages Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads, TikTok Ads, Amazon PPC, eBay Promoted Listings, Etsy Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads and display remarketing campaigns for businesses in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, across Pakistan and internationally.

Key facts:
- Founder and PPC expert: Syed Mudassir Shah
- Experience: 15 years in PPC and paid advertising
- Address: Scheme 3, Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan
- Phone and WhatsApp: 0343 5853835 (+92 343 5853835)
- Website: https://mrppc.pk
- Areas served: Islamabad, Rawalpindi, all of Pakistan, and clients in the UK, US, UAE and other markets
- Services: PPC audits, campaign setup, conversion tracking, ongoing management, consulting for in-house teams
- Clients keep ownership of their own ad accounts

## Services
- [Google Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/google-ads/): Search, Shopping, Performance Max, audits, conversion tracking and setup
- [Meta Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ads, lead generation, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, retargeting
- [TikTok Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/tiktok-ads/): Spark Ads, conversion campaigns, lead generation, creative testing
- [Amazon PPC expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/amazon-ads/): Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, ACoS and TACoS optimisation
- [eBay Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/ebay-ads/): Promoted Listings general and priority campaigns, ad rate strategy
- [Etsy Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/etsy-ads/): Etsy Ads and Offsite Ads, listing selection and optimisation
- [Microsoft Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/microsoft-ads/): Bing Ads, Google Ads import, UET tracking, LinkedIn profile targeting
- [LinkedIn Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/linkedin-ads/): B2B lead generation, Sponsored Content, Lead Gen Forms, account based campaigns
- [YouTube Ads expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/youtube-ads/): in-stream, Shorts, in-feed and Demand Gen video campaigns
- [Display and remarketing expert](https://mrppc.pk/services/display-remarketing/): Google Display Network, dynamic remarketing, Facebook retargeting
